text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens, have graduated from high school, and be over the age of 18. 2. Nationality Requirements Comply with the provisions of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (MOE) Document No. 12 [2020] (Jiaowaihan) For applicants who are former residents of Chinese Mainland (the Chinese mainland), Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan and have immigrated to a foreign country, and now apply as international students: They must obtain a valid foreign passport or nationality certification document by April 30, 2022, provide proof of cancellation of Chinese nationality, and have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Acumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) For applicants who were born with foreign nationality (where either or both parents are Chinese citizens and have settled abroad): They must have a record of actually residing abroad for more than 2 years from April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (A cumulative actual residence of 9 months or more in a foreign country within one year shall be counted as one full year, subject to entry and exit stamps.) Note: If an applicant is confirmed by Chinese public security authorities to hold Chinese nationality during the application, admission, or after enrollment, their application qualification, admission qualification, enrollment qualification will be cancelled, or they will be dismissed from school. 3. Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must provide the certificate of HSK 4 or above (200 or above). 4. Transcript of the "China Scholastic Competency Assessment"(CSCA Test).
